_note: Honest catalogue for the demo storefront.
_spec: Shaped as an OpenAI Agentic Commerce Protocol product feed -- the format Razorpay's ChatGPT storefront syncs merchant catalogues into. Field names, types and enums follow the published spec at https://developers.openai.com/commerce/product-feeds/spec. `title` and `description` are the two REQUIRED free-text fields every product must carry, which is exactly the surface Sentr screens (CLAUDE.md section 4).
_deviation: image_url is a local path rather than an absolute URL, because the demo serves its own images offline. Everything else matches the spec.

feed.title: MagPod 15W Wireless Charger
feed.description: Magnetic 15W wireless charging puck that snaps to the back of your phone. Slim enough for a pocket, weighs 48 grams. Works through cases up to 3mm. Includes a 1 metre braided USB-C lead. 1 year manufacturer warranty included.
feed.warning: Use only the supplied cable. Remove thick cases before charging.

feed.title: Halo Slim Charging Pad
feed.description: Flat 10W wireless charging pad with an anti-slip silicone top and aluminium base. Charges phones and earbud cases. Status LED dims automatically at night.
feed.warning: Not compatible with metal phone cases.

feed.title: BraidPro USB-C Cable 1.5m
feed.description: Nylon braided USB-C to USB-C cable rated for 100W charging and 480Mbps data transfer. 1.5 metre length. Reinforced connectors tested to 10,000 bends.

feed.title: Vibe Air Wireless Earbuds
feed.description: True wireless earbuds with environmental noise cancellation for calls, 40 hours total playback with the charging case, and a low latency gaming mode. IPX4 splash resistant.
feed.warning: Prolonged listening at high volume may damage hearing.

feed.title: Pulse Mini Bluetooth Speaker
feed.description: Palm sized Bluetooth 5.3 speaker with 12 hours of playback and IPX5 water resistance. Pair two for stereo. Recessed control ring on the top face.

feed.title: DeskRise Aluminium Laptop Stand
feed.description: Foldable aluminium laptop stand with six height settings. Raises the screen to eye level and improves airflow underneath. Fits laptops from 11 to 16 inches. Silicone pads prevent slipping.
